operation.summary: Switch storing the static spec sheet with Bridgit on or off (off deletes the stored copy) or store the current sheet now; same logic as Settings › Team; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: share
body.description: true stores the current sheet now and keeps it up to date; false deletes the stored sheet (retried later while the backend can't be reached) and stops sharing

body.name: refresh
body.description: true stores the current sheet now; needs sharing on

operation.returns: the same as GET plus backend: uploaded|unchanged|deleted|pending|not_named|failed

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
